title: Simple and Useful
body:
I’ve needed a simple streaks app for so long, and jumped from one app to another because so many carry too many features attached. All I need is something to look back and be reminded if I completed my task or not. That’s it. I can do that with Streaks here.
My only recommendation would be for an even more creative UI. I kick myself for ever having deleted a simple “Streaks” app that was just a calendar that you put an X on to show a day’s completion and that was it. Fun calendar designs to choose from. Also, maybe a “Notes” section, in case we need to add something for that day, like to remind ourselves about future improvements we can make for our Habit.
But this is an overall minimal yet practical app, and I appreciate that.
P.S. I put my volume up just to hear that lovely sound when I’ve complete a habit 🎵
